faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kalyani University Project Assistant (PA) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Kalyani University Project Assistant (PA) position is 21st September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant (PA) post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Bachelor's degree in Science, preferably in Chemistry, or an M.Sc. in Chemistry with at least 60% marks and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the Kalyani University Project Assistant (PA) position?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent via email to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for Project Assistant (PA) in Chemistry".

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant (PA) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 27,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Project Assistant (PA) position is as per the rules of the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF).

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Kalyani University Project Assistant (PA) vacancy?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on the candidate's performance in an interview.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant (PA) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Assistant (PA) position at Kalyani University.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is PA/Advt./Chemistry/2026/OP-586.

faq.question: Q9. Does the application require any specific experience?
faq.answer: For M.Sc. candidates, hands-on experience in Organic Synthesis is preferred.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Kalyani University located?
faq.answer: Kalyan University is located in Kalyani, West Bengal, with the pincode 741235.
